tree.name: Progress
tree.class: group/progress grid w-full grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-[var(--progress-gap,0.5rem)]

tree.name: ProgressIndicator
tree.class: block h-full [transition:width_calc(700ms*var(--kf-speed,1))_var(--ease-spring),background-color_calc(300ms*var(--kf-speed,1))_var(--ease-house)] data-indeterminate:w-2/5 data-indeterminate:animate-[kf-progress-slide_1.3s_cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)_infinite] motion-reduce:transition-none! motion-reduce:data-indeterminate:w-full motion-reduce:data-indeterminate:animate-none! rounded-[var(--progress-radius,9999px)] bg-[var(--progress-fill,var(--primary))] shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgb(255_255_255/0.14)] data-complete:bg-[var(--progress-complete,oklch(0.62_0.16_150))] motion-reduce:data-indeterminate:opacity-30

tree.name: ProgressTrack
tree.class: overflow-hidden relative col-span-full h-[var(--progress-height,0.375rem)] w-full rounded-[var(--progress-radius,9999px)] bg-[var(--progress-track,var(--muted))] shadow-[inset_0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.07),inset_0_0_0_1px_rgb(0_0_0/0.035)] dark:shadow-[inset_0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.5),inset_0_0_0_1px_rgb(255_255_255/0.04)]

tree.name: ProgressValue
tree.class: col-start-2 text-[13px] leading-5 text-[color:var(--progress-value-ink,var(--muted-foreground))] tabular-nums transition-colors duration-[calc(150ms*var(--kf-speed,1))] data-complete:text-[color:var(--progress-ink,var(--foreground))] motion-reduce:transition-none!
